# Asad

> Senior Full-Stack Engineer for remote teams and product builds. 8+ years building and scaling SaaS platforms, backend systems, and AI-enabled workflows with Node.js, NestJS, React, Angular, and AWS. Open to remote roles and freelance work.

## Core Expertise

- Building new SaaS features and products
- Joining remote product teams as a full-stack engineer
- Fixing slow or messy backend systems
- Migrating legacy code safely with zero downtime
- Building APIs and microservices architectures
- Improving performance and system reliability
- Adding AI features and document workflows

## Selected Architecture & Engineering Work

- [CloudDrive (Biztree)](https://asadcodes.com/#featured-case-study): Distributed file-storage microservice built with NestJS, event-driven processing, AWS S3, Lambda, and BullMQ. Handles 500K+ daily operations with sub-100ms response times, 45% faster uploads, and 99.9% uptime.
- [Biztree Business-in-a-Box](https://asadcodes.com/#projects): Unified microservices backend (NestJS, React, MongoDB, AWS) behind 5+ SaaS applications serving 12M+ users, with async processing via BullMQ and RabbitMQ.
- [RevBits PAM](https://asadcodes.com/#projects): Enterprise Privileged Access Management platform (React, NestJS, microservices) with real-time session forensics and audit logging. Won a Globee Gold Award (2022).
- [Arccos Golf](https://asadcodes.com/#projects): Real-time golf performance tracking system (React, Node.js) built with Microsoft, integrating wind and slope data. Improved tracking accuracy by 40%.
- [Ancera](https://asadcodes.com/#projects): ML-powered contamination detection pipelines (React, Node.js, machine learning) for food safety, cutting processing time by 90%.

## Experience & Proven Results

- Biztree — Senior Software Engineer, Remote (Jan 2023–Present): Architected a unified NestJS microservices backend for 12M+ users; led a zero-downtime MongoDB migration of 50M+ records; reduced API latency by 45%.
- InvoZone — Senior Software Engineer, Lahore, Pakistan (Oct 2021–Jan 2023): Built the RevBits PAM platform; hardened security against XSS, SQL injection, and brute-force attacks; won a Globee Gold Award for security innovation.
- TenX — Software Engineer, Lahore, Pakistan (Aug 2018–Oct 2021): Built full-stack systems for Ancera and Arccos Golf; ranked #3 in a global sports innovation award (Arccos).
- 8+ years of professional experience; AWS Certified; Top Rated Plus on Upwork.
